rows.label: Dungeons & Dragons
rows.hook: pioneered tabletop role-playing, where players roll a twenty-sided die while a game master narrates

rows.label: Magic: The Gathering
rows.hook: is a trading card game where players duel as powerful planeswalkers casting spells from a deck

rows.label: Hasbro
rows.description: American multinational toy and entertainment company
rows.hook: makes Monopoly, Transformers and Nerf blasters

rows.label: Mattel
rows.description: American multinational toy and entertainment company
rows.hook: makes Barbie dolls, the Uno card game and Fisher-Price baby toys

rows.label: The Pokémon Company
rows.description: Japanese brand management, production, and marketing company responsible for marketing and licensing the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: manages the franchise starring Pikachu, a yellow electric mouse, and its cards and games

rows.label: Wizards of the Coast
rows.hook: publishes a famous planeswalker card game and the world's best-known fantasy role-playing game

rows.label: The Lego Group
rows.description: Danish toy manufacturer best known for interlocking-brick construction toys
rows.hook: makes colorful plastic bricks that snap together, plus movies and theme parks

rows.label: Hot Wheels
rows.hook: makes tiny die-cast cars that race down orange plastic tracks with loops

rows.label: Games Workshop
rows.hook: makes painted-miniature tabletop battles set in a grim far future, like Warhammer 40,000

rows.label: Singer Corporation
rows.description: American manufacturer of sewing machines and Consumer Electronics
rows.hook: is a household name for machines that stitch fabric together at home

rows.label: Bandai
rows.description: Japanese toy making and video game company
rows.hook: makes Gundam model kits and Tamagotchi virtual pets

rows.label: Play-Doh
rows.description: modeling compound used by young children for art and craft projects
rows.hook: is a soft, colorful dough sold in little tubs for kids to squish and mold
